title: What is Dark Matter and Dark Energy?
speaker: Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell
zh: 【Kurzgesagt – In a Nutshell】什麼是暗物質和暗能量？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Matter, as we know it; Atoms, stars and galaxies, planets and trees, rocks and us.
cues.en: Matter, as we know it; Atoms, stars and galaxies, planets and trees, rocks and us.
cues.zh: 我們所熟知的物質： 原子、恆星、星系、行星、樹、岩石，以及我們。

cues.text: This matter accounts for less than 5% of the known universe.
cues.en: This matter accounts for less than 5% of the known universe.
cues.zh: 這些物質佔整個宇宙不到５%。

cues.text: About 25% is dark matter; and 70% is dark energy.
cues.en: About 25% is dark matter; and 70% is dark energy.
cues.zh: 這些物質佔整個宇宙不到５%。 在整個宇宙中， 大約２５%是暗物質，７０%是暗能量。

cues.text: Both of which are invisible.
cues.en: Both of which are invisible.
cues.zh: 暗物質與暗能量都無法被觀測到。

cues.text: This is kind of strange because it suggests that everything we experience is
cues.en: This is kind of strange because it suggests that everything we experience is
cues.zh: 這聽起來有點奇怪， 這表示我們所接觸到的世界只佔了極其微小的部分。

cues.text: really only a tiny fraction of reality.
cues.en: really only a tiny fraction of reality.
cues.zh: 這聽起來有點奇怪， 這表示我們所接觸到的世界只佔了極其微小的部分。

cues.text: But it gets worse.
cues.en: But it gets worse.
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是， 我們對暗物質與暗能量究竟是什麼、如何運作毫無頭緒

cues.text: We really have no clue what dark matter and energy are, or how they work.
cues.en: We really have no clue what dark matter and energy are, or how they work.
cues.zh: 更糟糕的是， 我們對暗物質與暗能量究竟是什麼、如何運作毫無頭緒

cues.text: We are pretty sure they exist though.
cues.en: We are pretty sure they exist though.
cues.zh: 我們非常確定它們是存在的。 至於，為什麼我們知道它們存在呢？

cues.text: So, what do we know?
cues.en: So, what do we know?
cues.zh: 我們非常確定它們是存在的。 至於，為什麼我們知道它們存在呢？

cues.text: Dark matter is the stuff that makes it possible for galaxies to exist.
cues.en: Dark matter is the stuff that makes it possible for galaxies to exist.
cues.zh: 暗物質使星系穩定存在

cues.text: When we calculated why the universe is structured the way it is, it quickly became clear that there's just not enough normal matter.
cues.en: When we calculated why the universe is structured the way it is, it quickly became clear that there's just not enough normal matter.
cues.zh: 我們開始分析宇宙的結構時，發現能被觀測的"普通物質"並不足以令宇宙維持穩定存在。

cues.text: The gravity of the visible matter is not strong enough to form galaxies and complex structures.
cues.en: The gravity of the visible matter is not strong enough to form galaxies and complex structures.
cues.zh: 來自"普通物質"的重力不足以形成星系這樣的複雜結構，恆星間會更為鬆散，並四處散佈，

cues.text: The stars would more likely be scattered all over the place and not form galaxies.
cues.en: The stars would more likely be scattered all over the place and not form galaxies.
cues.zh: 來自"普通物質"的重力不足以形成星系這樣的複雜結構，恆星間會更為鬆散，並四處散佈， 這將導致星系無法形成。 因此，我們確信一定有某種東西在維繫星系的結構。

cues.text: So, we know there is something else inside and around them.
cues.en: So, we know there is something else inside and around them.
cues.zh: 這將導致星系無法形成。 因此，我們確信一定有某種東西在維繫星系的結構。

cues.text: Something that doesn't emit or reflect light.
cues.en: Something that doesn't emit or reflect light.
cues.zh: 某種東西，它不發射光，也不反射光

cues.text: Something dark...
cues.en: Something dark...
cues.zh: 所以稱作「暗」。

cues.text: but besides being able to calculate the existence of dark matter,
cues.en: but besides being able to calculate the existence of dark matter,
cues.zh: 所以稱作「暗」。 除了能計算到暗物質的存在以外，

cues.text: we can see it... kind of.
cues.en: we can see it... kind of.
cues.zh: 我們還能看到它的微小跡象。 高濃度暗物質的地方會使經過它的光線扭曲。

cues.text: Places with a high concentration of dark matter bend light passing near by.
cues.en: Places with a high concentration of dark matter bend light passing near by.
cues.zh: 我們還能看到它的微小跡象。 高濃度暗物質的地方會使經過它的光線扭曲。

cues.text: So we know there's something there that interacts with gravity.
cues.en: So we know there's something there that interacts with gravity.
cues.zh: 我們還能看到它的微小跡象。 高濃度暗物質的地方會使經過它的光線扭曲。 因此我們確信有東西在那兒，並且會與重力作用。

cues.text: Right now, we have more ideas about what dark energy is not, than what it is!
cues.en: Right now, we have more ideas about what dark energy is not, than what it is!
cues.zh: 現在， 對於暗物質是什麼有進一步認識， 那麼它究竟是什麼？

cues.text: We know dark matter is not just clouds of normal matter without stars,
cues.en: We know dark matter is not just clouds of normal matter without stars,
cues.zh: 我們知道暗物質並非一團無光源的普通物質， 因為普通物質會放射出我們能觀測到的粒子。

cues.text: because it would emit particles we could detect.
cues.en: because it would emit particles we could detect.
cues.zh: 我們知道暗物質並非一團無光源的普通物質， 因為普通物質會放射出我們能觀測到的粒子。

cues.text: Dark matter is not anti-matter, because anti-matter produces unique gamma rays when it reacts with normal matter.
cues.en: Dark matter is not anti-matter, because anti-matter produces unique gamma rays when it reacts with normal matter.
cues.zh: 我們知道暗物質並非一團無光源的普通物質， 因為普通物質會放射出我們能觀測到的粒子。 暗物質也不是"反"物質， 因為反物質會與普通物質反應，並放出特殊的γ射線。

cues.text: Dark matter is also not made up of black holes,
cues.en: Dark matter is also not made up of black holes,
cues.zh: 暗物質也不是"反"物質， 因為反物質會與普通物質反應，並放出特殊的γ射線。 暗物質也不是由黑洞所構成。

cues.text: very compact objects that violently affect their surroundings,
cues.en: very compact objects that violently affect their surroundings,
cues.zh: 黑洞是種緊密的物體，且會劇烈影響周圍環境， 但是暗物質似乎是零星散佈在整個宇宙。

cues.text: while dark matter seems to be scattered all over the place.
cues.en: while dark matter seems to be scattered all over the place.
cues.zh: 黑洞是種緊密的物體，且會劇烈影響周圍環境， 但是暗物質似乎是零星散佈在整個宇宙。

cues.text: Basically, we only know 3 things for sure; 1. Something is out there.
cues.en: Basically, we only know 3 things for sure; 1. Something is out there.
cues.zh: 基本上，我們目前對於暗物質只能確定三件事： 一、有東西就在那裡。

cues.text: 2. It interacts with gravity.
cues.en: 2. It interacts with gravity.
cues.zh: 二、它會與重力作用。

cues.text: 3. There is a lot of it.
cues.en: 3. There is a lot of it.
cues.zh: 三、它們有很多很多。

cues.text: Dark matter is probably made up of a complicated exotic particle
cues.en: Dark matter is probably made up of a complicated exotic particle
cues.zh: 暗物質有可能是由某種複雜又特殊的粒子組成， 這種粒子不會與光、普通物質反應

cues.text: that doesn't interact with light and matter in a way we expect,
cues.en: that doesn't interact with light and matter in a way we expect,
cues.zh: 暗物質有可能是由某種複雜又特殊的粒子組成， 這種粒子不會與光、普通物質反應 但目前我們真的不瞭解它到底是什麼。

cues.text: but right now, we just don't know.
cues.en: but right now, we just don't know.
cues.zh: 但目前我們真的不瞭解它到底是什麼。

cues.text: Dark energy is even more strange and mysterious.
cues.en: Dark energy is even more strange and mysterious.
cues.zh: 暗能量又更奇怪與神秘： 我們無法檢測它、無法測量它、無法觸碰它。

cues.text: We can't detect it, we can't measure it and we can't taste it.
cues.en: We can't detect it, we can't measure it and we can't taste it.
cues.zh: 我們無法檢測它、無法測量它、無法觸碰它。

cues.text: But we do see its effects very clearly.
cues.en: But we do see its effects very clearly.
cues.zh: 我們無法檢測它、無法測量它、無法觸碰它。 帶我們卻能非常清晰地看到它造成的影響：

cues.text: In 1929, Edward Hubble examined how the wavelength of light
cues.en: In 1929, Edward Hubble examined how the wavelength of light
cues.zh: 帶我們卻能非常清晰地看到它造成的影響： 1929年，愛德溫·哈伯透過研究遙遠星系發出的光的波長，

cues.text: emitted by distant galaxies, shifts towards the red end
cues.en: emitted by distant galaxies, shifts towards the red end
cues.zh: 1929年，愛德溫·哈伯透過研究遙遠星系發出的光的波長， 發現光經過宇宙後出現紅移現象。

cues.text: of the electromagnetic spectrum as it travels through the space.
cues.en: of the electromagnetic spectrum as it travels through the space.
cues.zh: 發現光經過宇宙後出現紅移現象。

cues.text: He found that fainter, more distant galaxies showed a large degree of red shift;
cues.en: He found that fainter, more distant galaxies showed a large degree of red shift;
cues.zh: 哈伯發現較黯淡、較遙遠的星系會出現較大的紅移。

cues.text: closer galaxies, not so much.
cues.en: closer galaxies, not so much.
cues.zh: 距離近些的星系則出現紅移的幅度則小些。

cues.text: Hubble determined that this was because the universe itself is expanding.
cues.en: Hubble determined that this was because the universe itself is expanding.
cues.zh: 哈伯肯定地認為會出現紅移現象是因為宇宙正在膨脹，

cues.text: The red shift occurs, because the wavelengths of light
cues.en: The red shift occurs, because the wavelengths of light
cues.zh: 哈伯肯定地認為會出現紅移現象是因為宇宙正在膨脹， 紅移的出現，是因為光的波長隨宇宙膨脹而被拉伸。

cues.text: are stretched as the universe expands.
cues.en: are stretched as the universe expands.
cues.zh: 紅移的出現，是因為光的波長隨宇宙膨脹而被拉伸。

cues.text: More recent discoveries have shown that, the expansion of the universe is accelerating.
cues.en: More recent discoveries have shown that, the expansion of the universe is accelerating.
cues.zh: 近幾年的研究報告顯示宇宙的膨脹正在加速。

cues.text: Before that, it was thougth that the pull of gravity would cause the expansion to
cues.en: Before that, it was thougth that the pull of gravity would cause the expansion to
cues.zh: 近幾年的研究報告顯示宇宙的膨脹正在加速。 在此之前， 人們認為重力將使宇宙膨脹減緩，甚至塌縮回一個點。

cues.text: either slow down or even retract and collapse in on itself at some point.
cues.en: either slow down or even retract and collapse in on itself at some point.
cues.zh: 在此之前， 人們認為重力將使宇宙膨脹減緩，甚至塌縮回一個點。

cues.text: Space doesn't change its properties as it expands; there's just more of it.
cues.en: Space doesn't change its properties as it expands; there's just more of it.
cues.zh: 空間並沒有因為膨脹而改變它的性質。 宇宙膨脹就只是讓空間變更多！ 年輕的新空間一直在宇宙所有地方新生。

cues.text: New space is constantly created everywhere, galaxies are tight bound clusters of stuff held together by gravity
cues.en: New space is constantly created everywhere, galaxies are tight bound clusters of stuff held together by gravity
cues.zh: 年輕的新空間一直在宇宙所有地方新生。 星系是一種透過重力緊密叢集的東西。 因此身處星系中的我們不會感受到宇宙膨脹， 但我們仍能在任何地方看到膨脹的影響。

cues.text: so we don't experience this expansion in our daily lives.
cues.en: so we don't experience this expansion in our daily lives.
cues.zh: 因此身處星系中的我們不會感受到宇宙膨脹， 但我們仍能在任何地方看到膨脹的影響。

cues.text: But we see it everywhere around us.
cues.en: But we see it everywhere around us.
cues.zh: 因此身處星系中的我們不會感受到宇宙膨脹， 但我們仍能在任何地方看到膨脹的影響。 無論何處，宇宙中隨時都有新的空間在形成

cues.text: Wherever there is empty space in the universe, more is forming every second.
cues.en: Wherever there is empty space in the universe, more is forming every second.
cues.zh: 無論何處，宇宙中隨時都有新的空間在形成

cues.text: So, dark energy seems to be some kind of energy intrinsic to empty space.
cues.en: So, dark energy seems to be some kind of energy intrinsic to empty space.
cues.zh: 因此，暗能量似乎是某種空白空間裡固有的能量。 暗能量，比任何東西都要強大而且日益增強。

cues.text: Energy that is stronger than anything else we know and it keeps getting stronger as time passes by.
cues.en: Energy that is stronger than anything else we know and it keeps getting stronger as time passes by.
cues.zh: 暗能量，比任何東西都要強大而且日益增強。

cues.text: Empty space has more energy than everything else in the universe combined.
cues.en: Empty space has more energy than everything else in the universe combined.
cues.zh: 空白空間中的能量比起宇宙其他所有東西的總和還要多

cues.text: We have multiple ideas about what dark energy might be.
cues.en: We have multiple ideas about what dark energy might be.
cues.zh: 我們對於暗能量可能是什麼有多種猜測。

cues.text: One idea is, the dark energy is not a thing, but just a property of space.
cues.en: One idea is, the dark energy is not a thing, but just a property of space.
cues.zh: 一種猜測是暗能量並非某種事物，它只是空間的特性。

cues.text: Empty space is not nothing, it has its own energy.
cues.en: Empty space is not nothing, it has its own energy.
cues.zh: 空白空間並非"虛無"，它擁有自己的能量。 空白空間可以產生更多空間，而且相當活躍。

cues.text: It can generate more space and is quite active.
cues.en: It can generate more space and is quite active.
cues.zh: 空白空間可以產生更多空間，而且相當活躍。 因此當宇宙在膨脹時，空白空間使更多空間出現並填補缺口，造成宇宙加速膨脹。

cues.text: So, as the universe expands, it could be that just more and more space
cues.en: So, as the universe expands, it could be that just more and more space
cues.zh: 因此當宇宙在膨脹時，空白空間使更多空間出現並填補缺口，造成宇宙加速膨脹。

cues.text: appears to fill the gaps and this leads to a faster expanding universe.
cues.en: appears to fill the gaps and this leads to a faster expanding universe.
cues.zh: 因此當宇宙在膨脹時，空白空間使更多空間出現並填補缺口，造成宇宙加速膨脹。

cues.text: This idea is close to an idea that Einstein had back in 1917,
cues.en: This idea is close to an idea that Einstein had back in 1917,
cues.zh: 這個猜測接近愛因斯坦在1917年對宇宙常數概念的想法。

cues.text: of the concept of a cosmological constant, a force that counteracted the force of gravity.
cues.en: of the concept of a cosmological constant, a force that counteracted the force of gravity.
cues.zh: 這個猜測接近愛因斯坦在1917年對宇宙常數概念的想法。 有一種力與重力對抗著。 唯一的問題是，當我們嘗試這樣計算暗能量的多寡時， 會出現詭異的結果，留下更多困惑與謎題。

cues.text: The only problem is, that when we tried to calculate the amount of this energy
cues.en: The only problem is, that when we tried to calculate the amount of this energy
cues.zh: 唯一的問題是，當我們嘗試這樣計算暗能量的多寡時， 會出現詭異的結果，留下更多困惑與謎題。

cues.text: the result was so wrong and weird, that it only added to the confusion.
cues.en: the result was so wrong and weird, that it only added to the confusion.
cues.zh: 唯一的問題是，當我們嘗試這樣計算暗能量的多寡時， 會出現詭異的結果，留下更多困惑與謎題。

cues.text: Another idea is, that empty space is actually full of temporary, virtual particles that spontaneously and continually
cues.en: Another idea is, that empty space is actually full of temporary, virtual particles that spontaneously and continually
cues.zh: 另一種猜測是空白空間充斥著一種暫時且虛無飄渺的粒子，它會不斷從一無所有形成，然後再消失回一無所有。

cues.text: form from nothing and then dissapear into nothing again.
cues.en: form from nothing and then dissapear into nothing again.
cues.zh: 另一種猜測是空白空間充斥著一種暫時且虛無飄渺的粒子，它會不斷從一無所有形成，然後再消失回一無所有。

cues.text: The energy form those particles could be dark energy.
cues.en: The energy form those particles could be dark energy.
cues.zh: 這些粒子的能量可能就是暗能量。

cues.text: Or maybe dark energy is an unknown kind of dynamic energy fluid or field
cues.en: Or maybe dark energy is an unknown kind of dynamic energy fluid or field
cues.zh: 或是另一種猜測：暗能量是種未知的動態能量流體或是力場，它滲入了整個宇宙。

cues.text: which permeates the entire universe, but somehow has the opposite effect
cues.en: which permeates the entire universe, but somehow has the opposite effect
cues.zh: 或是另一種猜測：暗能量是種未知的動態能量流體或是力場，它滲入了整個宇宙。 但不知何故，它有與普通物質、普通能量相反的效果。

cues.text: on the universe than normal energy and matter.
cues.en: on the universe than normal energy and matter.
cues.zh: 但不知何故，它有與普通物質、普通能量相反的效果。

cues.text: But if it exists, we don't know how and where or how we could detect it.
cues.en: But if it exists, we don't know how and where or how we could detect it.
cues.zh: 如果真是如此，我們並不知道怎麼、在哪探測到它。

cues.text: So there are still a lot of questions to answer.
cues.en: So there are still a lot of questions to answer.
cues.zh: 如果真是如此，我們並不知道怎麼、在哪探測到它。 所以目前還有許多問題待解決。 我們關於暗物質、暗能量的理論仍處於理論階段。

cues.text: Our theories about dark matter and dark energy are still just that;
cues.en: Our theories about dark matter and dark energy are still just that;
cues.zh: 我們關於暗物質、暗能量的理論仍處於理論階段。

cues.text: theories.
cues.en: theories.
cues.zh: 我們關於暗物質、暗能量的理論仍處於理論階段。 一方面而言，這挺令人洩氣的； 另一方面，因為這是最前端的科學，因此使人興奮，

cues.text: On one hand, this is kind of frustrating, on the other hand this is frontier science
cues.en: On one hand, this is kind of frustrating, on the other hand this is frontier science
cues.zh: 一方面而言，這挺令人洩氣的； 另一方面，因為這是最前端的科學，因此使人興奮，

cues.text: making it very exciting.
cues.en: making it very exciting.
cues.zh: 一方面而言，這挺令人洩氣的； 另一方面，因為這是最前端的科學，因此使人興奮，

cues.text: It shows us that no matter how much we feel we're on top of things, we are still very much apes with smartphones, on a tiny
cues.en: It shows us that no matter how much we feel we're on top of things, we are still very much apes with smartphones, on a tiny
cues.zh: 這代表著無論我們多麼認為自己是萬物之王，但其實只是活在宇宙中脆弱小島並使用智慧型手機的猿人。 因此，去仰望這片天空吧！去追尋宇宙執行的真理！
